item.name: CHS-09 Oracle-lite on a healthy system (INV-1, INV-3, INV-8)

request.description: Hệ thống khỏe phải sạch mọi vi phạm: dùng làm "baseline" trước khi tiêm lỗi.

exec: (async function () { try {
const W = pm.environment.get("wallet_base_url"), P = pm.environment.get("payment_base_url");
const J = function (k, d) { try { return JSON.parse(pm.environment.get(k) || d); } catch (e) { return JSON.parse(d); } };
const SET = function (k, v) { pm.environment.set(k, JSON.stringify(v)); };
const sleep = function (ms) { return new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(r, ms); }); };
const call = function (o) { return new Promise(function (resolve) { pm.sendRequest(o, function (err, res) { resolve({ err: err, res: res }); }); }); };
const hC = function (t, c) { return { "x-tenant-id": t, "x-customer-id": c, "content-type": "application/json" }; };

const hO = function (t) { return { "x-tenant-id": t, "x-actor-id": pm.environment.get("actor_id") || "qa.tester", "x-actor-role": pm.environment.get("actor_role") || "OPS", "content-type": "application/json" }; };

const get0 = async function (url, headers) { const r = await call({ url: url, method: "GET", header: headers || {} }); if (r.err || !r.res) { return { status: 0, body: null }; } let b = null; try { b = r.res.json(); } catch (e) { b = null; } return { status: r.res.code, body: b }; };

const post0 = async function (url, headers, body) { const r = await call({ url: url, method: "POST", header: headers || {}, body: { mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify(body || {}) } }); if (r.err || !r.res) { return { status: 0, body: null }; } let b = null; try { b = r.res.json(); } catch (e) { b = null; } return { status: r.res.code, body: b }; };
const retried = async function (fn) { let r = null; for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { r = await fn(); if (r.status !== 0 && r.status < 500) { return r; } await sleep(500); } return r; };
const get = function (url, headers) { return retried(function () { return get0(url, headers); }); };
const post = function (url, headers, body) { return retried(function () { return post0(url, headers, body); }); };

const entriesOf = async function (t, c) { let all = [], cur = null; for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) { const r = await get(W + "/wallet/entries?limit=1000" + (cur ? "&cursor=" + cur : ""), hC(t, c)); if (r.status !== 200) { return null; } all = all.concat(r.body.items); if (!r.body.nextCursor) { break; } cur = r.body.nextCursor; } return all; };

const settlementsOf = async function () { const days = [new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), new Date(Date.now() - 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10)]; let all = []; for (const d of days) { let cur = null; for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) { const r = await get(P + "/settlements?date=" + d + "&limit=1000" + (cur ? "&cursor=" + cur : "")); if (r.status !== 200) { return null; } all = all.concat(r.body.items); if (!r.body.nextCursor) { break; } cur = r.body.nextCursor; } } return all; };

const actionsOf = async function (t) { let all = [], cur = null; for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) { const r = await get(W + "/ops/actions?limit=200" + (cur ? "&cursor=" + cur : ""), hO(t)); if (r.status !== 200) { return null; } all = all.concat(r.body.items); if (!r.body.nextCursor) { break; } cur = r.body.nextCursor; } return all; };
const strictChecks = async function (allowPending) {
const v = [];
const custs = J("ch_custs", "[]"), topups = J("ch_topups", "[]");
// INV-8: phục hồi

for (const [name, url] of [["wallet", W + "/health"], ["payment", P + "/health"]]) { const r = await get(url); if (r.status !== 200) { v.push({ code: "HEALTH_FAILED", detail: name + " status " + r.status }); } }
const entries = {};
for (const x of custs) {
const k = x.t + "|" + x.c;
const w = await get(W + "/wallet", hC(x.t, x.c));
if (w.status !== 200) { v.push({ code: "READ_FAILED", detail: k + " GET /wallet " + w.status }); continue; }
const e = await entriesOf(x.t, x.c);
if (e === null) { v.push({ code: "READ_FAILED", detail: k + " entries" }); continue; }
entries[k] = e;
// INV-1: số dư = tổng các dòng sổ cái
const sum = e.reduce(function (a, i) { return a + i.amount; }, 0);
if (sum !== w.body.balance) { v.push({ code: "BALANCE_DRIFT", detail: k + " balance " + w.body.balance + " != sum(entries) " + sum }); }
// INV-2/3: mỗi businessKey chỉ một dòng
const seen = {};
e.forEach(function (i) { seen[i.businessKey] = (seen[i.businessKey] || 0) + 1; });
Object.keys(seen).forEach(function (bk) { if (seen[bk] > 1) { v.push({ code: "DUPLICATE_BUSINESS_KEY", detail: k + " " + bk + " x" + seen[bk] }); } });
// một giao dịch không được nằm trong hai dòng cùng ví với dấu cùng chiều (giao dịch rỗng/trùng id)
const sett = await settlementsOf();
if (sett === null) { v.push({ code: "READ_FAILED", detail: "settlements" }); }
// INV-3: topup đã được client xác nhận phải khớp charge
for (const tp of topups) {
const k = tp.t + "|" + tp.c;
const g = await get(W + "/topups/" + tp.id, hC(tp.t, tp.c));
if (g.status !== 200) { v.push({ code: "ACKED_TOPUP_MISSING", detail: tp.id + " GET /topups " + g.status }); continue; }
const st = g.body.status;
const ents = (entries[k] || []).filter(function (i) { return i.businessKey === "topup:" + tp.id; });
const charges = (sett || []).filter(function (i) { return i.reference === tp.id; });
if (st === "REQUESTED" || st === "PENDING") { if (!allowPending) { v.push({ code: "TOPUP_NOT_SETTLED", detail: tp.id + " " + st }); } continue; }
if (st === "SUCCEEDED") {
if (ents.length !== 1) { v.push({ code: "TOPUP_TX_MISSING", detail: tp.id + " entries " + ents.length }); }
else if (ents[0].amount !== tp.amount) { v.push({ code: "SUM_MISMATCH", detail: tp.id + " entry " + ents[0].amount + " != " + tp.amount }); }
const ok = charges.filter(function (i) { return i.status === "SUCCEEDED" && i.amount === tp.amount; });
if (ok.length !== 1) { v.push({ code: "CHARGE_TOPUP_NOT_SUCCEEDED", detail: tp.id + " matching SUCCEEDED charges " + ok.length }); }
} else if (st === "FAILED") {
if (ents.length !== 0) { v.push({ code: "FAILED_TOPUP_HAS_ENTRY", detail: tp.id }); }
if (charges.length > 1) { v.push({ code: "DUPLICATE_CHARGE_REF", detail: tp.id + " charges " + charges.length }); }
return { v: v, entries: entries };
const r = await strictChecks(false); const vio = r.v;
const GROUP = ["HEALTH_FAILED","READ_FAILED"];
const mine = vio.filter(function (x) { return GROUP.indexOf(x.code) >= 0; });
pm.test("INV-8 phục hồi: không có vi phạm", function () { pm.expect(mine, JSON.stringify(mine.slice(0, 8))).to.have.lengthOf(0); });
const GROUP = ["BALANCE_DRIFT","DUPLICATE_BUSINESS_KEY"];
const mine = vio.filter(function (x) { return GROUP.indexOf(x.code) >= 0; });
pm.test("INV-1/INV-2 sổ cái: không có vi phạm", function () { pm.expect(mine, JSON.stringify(mine.slice(0, 8))).to.have.lengthOf(0); });
const GROUP = ["TOPUP_TX_MISSING","SUM_MISMATCH","CHARGE_TOPUP_NOT_SUCCEEDED","DUPLICATE_CHARGE_REF","FAILED_TOPUP_HAS_ENTRY","TOPUP_NOT_SETTLED"];
const mine = vio.filter(function (x) { return GROUP.indexOf(x.code) >= 0; });
pm.test("INV-3 nạp tiền khớp payment: không có vi phạm", function () { pm.expect(mine, JSON.stringify(mine.slice(0, 8))).to.have.lengthOf(0); });
} catch (e) { pm.test("Script không ném lỗi: " + e.message, function () { throw e; }); } })();

item.name: Workload
WLD-01 Topup (retry same key until acknowledged)

request.description: Mỗi lượt lặp (iteration) gửi một topup mới; nếu lần trước gặp lỗi 5xx hoặc mất kết nối thì **gửi lại cùng `Idempotency-Key`** (client đúng chuẩn). Chỉ topup nhận `202` mới được ghi vào danh sách "đã xác nhận" (INV-7).

exec: const custs = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("ch_custs") || "[]");
if (!custs.length) { throw new Error("Chạy folder Smoke trước (chưa có customer)"); }
let raw = pm.environment.get("ch_pending_topup"); let p = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;

if (!p) { const x = custs[pm.info.iteration % custs.length]; p = { t: x.t, c: x.c, key: pm.variables.replaceIn("{{$guid}}"), amount: 1000 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 9000) }; pm.environment.set("ch_pending_topup", JSON.stringify(p)); }
["t","c","key","amount"].forEach(function (k) { pm.environment.set("ch_p_" + k, String(p[k])); });
const stats = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("ch_stats") || "{}"); const s = stats.topup = stats.topup || { sent: 0, acked: 0, retry: 0, bad: 0 }; s.sent++;
const code = pm.response.code; const p = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("ch_pending_topup"));

if (code === 202) { const id = pm.response.json().topupId; const l = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("ch_topups") || "[]"); if (!l.some(function (x) { return x.id === id; })) { l.push({ t: p.t, c: p.c, id: id, amount: p.amount, key: p.key }); } pm.environment.set("ch_topups", JSON.stringify(l)); pm.environment.set("ch_pending_topup", ""); s.acked++; }
else if (code >= 500) { s.retry++; }

else { s.bad++; const b = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("ch_bad") || "[]"); b.push({ req: "topup", code: code, body: pm.response.text().slice(0, 200) }); pm.environment.set("ch_bad", JSON.stringify(b)); pm.environment.set("ch_pending_topup", ""); }
pm.environment.set("ch_stats", JSON.stringify(stats));
pm.test("Topup: 202 hoặc lỗi 5xx tạm thời (không có 4xx bất ngờ)", function () { pm.expect(code === 202 || code >= 500, "status " + code).to.be.true; });

item.name: WLD-02 Ops adjust / reverse (retry same key until acknowledged)

request.description: Lặp: CREDIT cho một ví, cứ 3 lượt thì đảo một điều chỉnh đã được xác nhận. Lỗi 5xx/mất kết nối thì gửi lại **cùng `idempotencyKey`**.

exec: const custs = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("ch_custs") || "[]");
if (!custs.length) { throw new Error("Chạy folder Smoke trước (chưa có customer)"); }
const W = pm.environment.get("wallet_base_url");
let raw = pm.environment.get("ch_pending_op"); let p = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
if (!p) { const it = pm.info.iteration; const idem = pm.variables.replaceIn("{{$guid}}"); const open = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("ch_adj_open") || "[]");

if (it % 3 === 2 && open.length) { const o = open.shift(); pm.environment.set("ch_adj_open", JSON.stringify(open)); p = { kind: "REVERSE", t: o.t, c: o.c, url: W + "/ops/transactions/" + o.txId + "/reversals", body: { reason: "chaos reverse", idempotencyKey: idem }, reverses: o.txId }; }

else { const x = custs[it % custs.length]; p = { kind: "ADJUST", t: x.t, c: x.c, url: W + "/ops/wallets/" + x.c + "/adjustments", body: { direction: "CREDIT", amount: 500 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 4500), currency: "VND", reason: "chaos adjust", idempotencyKey: idem } }; }
pm.environment.set("ch_pending_op", JSON.stringify(p)); }
pm.environment.set("ch_op_t", p.t); pm.environment.set("ch_op_url", p.url); pm.environment.set("ch_op_body", JSON.stringify(p.body));
const stats = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("ch_stats") || "{}"); const s = stats.ops = stats.ops || { sent: 0, acked: 0, retry: 0, final4xx: 0, bad: 0 }; s.sent++;
const code = pm.response.code; const p = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("ch_pending_op"));

if (code === 201) { const r = pm.response.json(); const l = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("ch_ops") || "[]"); if (!l.some(function (x) { return x.actionId === r.actionId; })) { l.push({ kind: p.kind, t: p.t, c: p.c, actionId: r.actionId, txId: r.transactionId, url: p.url, body: p.body, reverses: p.reverses || null }); } pm.environment.set("ch_ops", JSON.stringify(l));
if (p.kind === "ADJUST") { const o = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("ch_adj_open") || "[]"); o.push({ t: p.t, c: p.c, txId: r.transactionId }); pm.environment.set("ch_adj_open", JSON.stringify(o)); }
pm.environment.set("ch_pending_op", ""); s.acked++; }
else if (code >= 500) { s.retry++; }
else if (code === 409) { s.final4xx++; pm.environment.set("ch_pending_op", ""); }

else { s.bad++; const b = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("ch_bad") || "[]"); b.push({ req: "ops", code: code, body: pm.response.text().slice(0, 200) }); pm.environment.set("ch_bad", JSON.stringify(b)); pm.environment.set("ch_pending_op", ""); }
pm.environment.set("ch_stats", JSON.stringify(stats));
pm.test("Ops: 201, 409 hợp lệ hoặc lỗi 5xx tạm thời (không có 4xx bất ngờ)", function () { pm.expect(code === 201 || code === 409 || code >= 500, "status " + code).to.be.true; });
